entities.name: PMID:27502180
observations: Imaging-genomics study of presurgery MRI volumetric phenotypes and gene-expression pathways in 141 GBM patients; pathway analyses used available expression data from 91 patients.
Features included necrotic core, contrast enhancement, tumor bulk, FLAIR edema, total tumor volume, and component ratios.

entities.name: GBM MRI pathway enrichment
observations: In 91 GBM cases with expression data, MRI volumetric features showed diverse pathway enrichment by preranked gene-set enrichment analysis (FDR < 0.05); necrotic core and tumor bulk enriched immune-response and apoptosis pathways, contrast enhancement signal transduction and protein folding, and edema homeostasis and cell-cycle pathways.
The observational imaging-genomics analysis supports pathway associations, not causal validation of pathway drivers.

entities.name: GBM volumetric prognosis
observations: FLAIR edema was the strongest predictor of molecular GBM subtype (AUC 0.61); contrast enhancement was the strongest overall-survival predictor (C-index 0.60, Noether p=0.0004) in the reported cohort.
